scenario: 今天 7 篇都在处理生成式推荐落地时的问题，包括 Semantic ID 怎么编、整页结果怎么生成以及推理成本怎么降。UniRec 和 CSG4Rec 改进 Semantic ID 的构造，前者缓解热门编码垄断曝光，后者把协同行为信号编进 ID。快手的 GLASS 把长期行为接进生成过程，Netflix 的 GenPage 用一个模型逐个生成首页的行和影片，快手的 OneLatent 把先写推理再输出 SID 的过程压成几个隐式 token。另外两篇研究基于大模型的对话推荐，一篇改进评测指标，一篇让模型决定每轮该追问还是直接推荐。

papers.title: UniRec: A Unified Expressive-Aligned Generative Recommendation Framework for E-commerce
papers.authors: Ziliang Wang, Gaoyun Lin, Xuesi Wang, Shaoqiang Liang, Yili Huang, Weijie Bian, Li Zhang, Mingchen Cai, Jian Dong, Guanxing Zhang
papers.summary: 生成式推荐逐层生成商品的 Semantic ID，在生成第一层之前看不到任何商品侧信息，这是它和判别式排序模型之间的差距：判别模型给候选打分时能直接看到商品的类目、店铺、品牌这些特征，和用户特征做交叉。UniRec 先让模型生成商品的类目，再在已知类目的条件下生成 Semantic ID，相当于在解码路径里补回判别模型能用的商品特征。上线后订单提高 4.76%，GMV 提高 5.60%。
papers.abstract: UniRec unifies a multi-stage e-commerce recommendation pipeline in one generative model while recovering item-side feature crossing through Chain-of-Attribute generation before Semantic IDs. It adds exposure-weighted load balancing, scenario-conditioned decoding, and reward-driven plus preference optimization. Online A/B tests report page-view CTR gains of 5.37%, orders gains of 4.76%, and GMV gains of 5.60%.

papers.title: OneLatent: Latent Reasoning for Efficient Foundation Recommendation Models
papers.authors: Hao Jiang, Peiru Du, Pengfei Yao, Mengting Li, Siyuan Lou, Kuo Cai, Sheng Yu, Qiang Luo, Jian Liang, Ruiming Tang, Fei Pan, Peng Jiang, Wenwu Ou
papers.summary: 把大语言模型当作推荐底座时，让模型先写一段自然语言推理再输出下一个物品的语义编码，推理文本比语义编码长得多，解码时间和吞吐都被它拖住。OneLatent 的做法是在用户上下文后面接 3 个固定的特殊 token，训练分几步：先让模型在这些 token 之后复现教师大模型写的推理文本，再改成在它们之后直接输出目标语义编码；上线时只接这些 token，不生成任何推理文字。在工业数据上，OneLatent 前 64 个候选的语义编码命中率比先写推理再作答高 17.44%，推理吞吐是显式推理的 17.49 倍。
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong reasoning capabilities, motivating their use as the backbone of foundation recommendation models (FRMs). Existing methods enhance recommendations through explicit Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning under a Think-then-Answer paradigm. However, explicit CoT incurs substantial inference overhead by generating lengthy reasoning traces and relies on manually designed templates that struggle to capture diverse, dynamic user interests. We propose OneLatent, an efficient latent reasoning framework that compresses explicit reasoning traces into several learnable latent tokens, enabling Latent-Reason-then-Answer inference without generating verbose traces. OneLatent first introduces Multi-View Adaptive CoT (MV-ACoT), which creates diverse, high-quality teacher-generated supervision by exploring user interests from multiple perspectives and automatically adapting reasoning complexity to each instance. Building on pretrained FRMs, it then uses a three-stage latent-token alignment paradigm to progressively internalize CoT traces into learnable latent tokens. Experiments on an industrial-scale Kuaishou dataset and the public Kuaishou LLM-Rec benchmark show that OneLatent consistently outperforms explicit CoT-based methods and traditional baselines. Compared with the Think and No-Think variants of FRMs, OneLatent improves SID@64 by 17.44% and 9.33%, respectively, while achieving over 17x higher online inference throughput. An online A/B test in Kuaishou's local-services advertising scenario shows an estimated 9.6% revenue lift over strong online baselines.

papers.title: GenPage: Towards End-to-End Generative Homepage Construction at Netflix
papers.authors: Lequn Wang, Jiangwei Pan, Linas Baltrunas
papers.summary: Netflix 首页原来由多阶段推荐系统拼出来，先召回候选行和候选影片、再分别排序、最后组页，GenPage 改用一个 decoder-only Transformer 直接生成整页。首页由多行组成，每行是一个主题。用户历史、账号属性和请求信息编码成 prompt，模型按从左到右、从上到下的顺序逐个生成行 token 和影片 token。训练照搬大模型的流程，先在线上获得正反馈的首页上做下一 token 预测预训练，再用加权二分类或强化学习做后训练：前者给每个曝光的行或影片按用户反馈的正负定标签、按奖励大小定权重，后者按整页曝光影片的奖励之和来优化。它在 14 天 A/B 中把 Netflix 用来决定新算法能否上线的核心用户互动指标提升 0.24%，端到端延迟降低 20%。
papers.abstract: GenPage replaces Netflix's multi-stage homepage recommender with a transformer that autoregressively generates an entire structured multi-row homepage. It is pretrained on positively engaged production pages and post-trained using weighted binary classification or reinforcement learning, with mechanisms for cold start, freshness, business rules, and serving efficiency. Online A/B tests report a 0.24% engagement lift and 20% lower end-to-end latency.

papers.title: Coarse-to-Fine Long-term Interest Modeling for Generative Recommendation
papers.authors: Shiteng Cao, Junda She, Ji Liu, Bin Zeng, Chengcheng Guo, Kuo Cai, Qiang Luo, Ruiming Tang, Han Li, Kun Gai, Zhiheng Li, Cheng Yang
papers.summary: 生成式推荐一个码一个码地生成下一个物品的 Semantic ID，注意力计算量随序列长度平方增长，所以这类模型通常只吃最近几十条行为，用不上长期历史。GLASS 按 Semantic ID 的层级分开用长期历史。生成第一层码之前，它给每个一级码取该类物品向量的平均当原型。再把余弦相似度区间等分成若干档，统计长期历史里和原型的相似度落在每一档的物品数，所有一级码的计数拼起来经一个小网络压成一个兴趣 token 送进编码器；第一层码生成之后，拿它当检索键，从长期历史里取出同一大类的物品，辅助生成后两层码。在 TAOBAO-MM 上，R@1 比最强基线高 21.57%；短视频平台两周 A/B 中，召回率绝对提升 3 个百分点。
papers.abstract: Generative recommendation is a coarse-to-fine process in which Semantic ID prefixes determine broad categories and suffixes identify items. GLASS injects distinct long-term user signals into these stages through SID-Tier for prefix generation and semantic hard search with gated fusion for suffix generation. Experiments on TAOBAO-MM and KuaiRec outperform prior baselines, and a two-week online A/B test on a short-video platform reports significant recommendation-quality gains.

papers.title: CSG4Rec: Collaborative-Similarity Guided Semantic IDs Tokenization for Generative Sequential Recommendation
papers.authors: Wei Liu, Bo Yang, Qianyang Zhu, Ruijie Xiao, Sirui Huang, Qing Li
papers.summary: 生成式推荐把每件商品编成一串 Semantic ID，这项工作发现，把用户行为上的相似关系直接放进编 ID 的空间里学，比事后再去对齐效果更好，在三个常用数据集上都超过了已有的强基线。现有做法先按商品内容编好 ID，再拿 ID 的向量去对齐协同过滤学到的 embedding，但两种向量不在同一个空间里，硬对齐效果有限，也学不到哪些商品常被同一批用户购买。它改为先用协同过滤给每件商品找出行为上相近和不相近的商品，再让前者的 ID 向量靠近、后者远离。它还把用户交互过的商品的文本向量合起来，同样编成用户的 Semantic ID，和商品 ID 一起输入生成模型。==商品 ID 不光要反映内容，也要反映哪些人会一起买它==。
papers.abstract: The paper proposes collaborative-similarity guided semantic-ID tokenization that fuses semantic and collaborative information in one space. It also constructs user semantic IDs to capture preference characteristics and builds CSG4Rec for generative sequential recommendation. The method is designed to address the mismatch between content-derived identifiers and collaborative behavior signals.

papers.title: Evaluating LLM-based conversational recommenders with semantic and genre-aware metrics
papers.authors: Darshna Parmar, Dhruv Shah, Pramit Mazumdar, Saurav Mallik
papers.summary: 让大模型陪用户聊天、给他推荐电影时，常用的 Recall@K 和 BLEU 只看推荐的是不是数据集里用户最后选的那一部，可很多没对上的推荐其实也合他的口味。在 ReDial 和 INSPIRED 两个电影推荐对话数据集上，这项研究统计到，标准答案只有 39% 的时候出现在前 10 个推荐里，而在推荐出的所有电影中，有 53% 至少和标准答案属于同一类型。他们据此加了按电影类型计分的指标，前 10 个推荐里只要有和标准答案同类型的电影，就算推荐对了，再用同一套流程比较了六个指令微调过的大模型。结果是模型越大不一定推荐得越好，是否接入知识图谱、给多少上下文影响更大。==评测对话推荐，要看推荐是否对上用户的偏好，而不只看有没有猜中唯一答案==。
papers.abstract: Conversational recommender systems powered by large language models generate fluent dialogue but remain difficult to evaluate with lexical metrics. This study benchmarks systems on ReDial and INSPIRED using a pipeline that combines natural-language understanding, dialogue management, knowledge-graph reasoning and LLM generation. It introduces genre-aware measures for preference alignment and analyzes how model size, knowledge grounding and context affect quality and hallucination.

papers.title: Integrating implicit desire fusion for proactive conversational recommendation systems with LLMs
papers.authors: Sitong Yan, Shengli Song, Chengen Lai, Jingyang Li, Guangneng Hu
papers.summary: 对话推荐时，先从用户零散的几句话里推断他真正想要什么，再决定追问还是推荐，成功率会高得多。在 LastFM 音乐推荐上，让 GPT-3.5-Turbo 和模拟用户对话，加上这一步后，15 轮内推荐成功的比例从 0.327 提高到 0.583。比如用户先说想听点安静的音乐，又补一句不要快节奏，过去常听爵士和氛围音乐。DESIRE 让大模型把这些话、他的收听记录、检索到的歌曲信息，比如某首爵士乐节奏很慢，和他刚拒绝过的歌放在一起，推断他真正的需求。之后大模型判断这些信息够不够推荐，不够就追问，比如直接问或让用户在两个选项里比较，够了就推荐，并用摆证据或打感情牌这类方式说服，回复里提到的歌曲属性以检索到的信息为依据。
papers.abstract: The paper introduces DESIRE, a desire-oriented conversational recommendation framework combining implicit desire exploration with recommendation strategy planning. It targets precision, proactivity and persuasion in user-centric dialogue. Evaluation on LastFM and Yelp reports improved recommendation quality and dialogue persuasiveness in music and e-commerce scenarios.
